lines: Stop packing running shoes for Disney.
I tested the popular ones, so you don't have to.
Super cushy at first, but by lunch my knees were done.
Nike Air Max, five out of ten.
That narrow toe box had me hunting for a bench by hour five.
Comfy, until the memory foam goes flat.
The toe box is wide, and the arch support doesn't quit.
22,000 steps, and my feet were fine at the fireworks.
Don't ruin the trip you saved all year for.

primary_text:
Disney means 8–10 hours on your feet: cobblestones, lines, and miles between rides. Most sneakers are built for running, not for standing in line at hour seven.

The ComfortWear Ortho Stretch Shoe:
👣 Wide toe box, so swollen feet still have room
🦶 Arch support that's still there at the fireworks
☁️ Cushioned rocker sole for 20,000-step park days

Pack the shoes that make it to the fireworks 🎆
